reason_summary: Prompt asked the Treasury Authority Agent to run the TMS: move cash, execute the FX hedge, place the MMF, sweep the intercompany balance, pledge collateral. KYE governs WHETHER a corporate-treasury action may proceed (within mandate/limit, authorised, in-scope, evidenced) and proves the basis; it does NOT move funds, execute trades, place investments, or run a TMS. A TMS engine is a §0.30 competing system, and a parallel treasury rule-pack would fork the existing kye:rule-pack:treasury (§0).
remediation_hint: Re-scope to the bounded governance act: admit -> decide (§12) against the existing kye:rule-pack:treasury (incl. kye:rule:treasury_dual_control_above_100k) -> record disposition (§21) -> seal Evidence Pack + Treasury Authority Proof (§13) -> hold the irreversible FX-hedge, MMF investment, intercompany funding, and collateral pledge/recall advisory until §36 two-person sign-off by a named treasurer. The TMS, dealing platform, and bank rails stay the customer's; bind the existing DORA + PRA SS1/23 maps.
